findings.title: Malformed waiver expires date failed OPEN (permanent bypass by typo)
findings.question: error-handling
findings.whatBreaks: a waiver whose expires value is present but unparseable (a typo) silently never expired and the gate printed PASS, exempting a security surface forever; contradicts the fail-closed rule and ADR-0017's Confirmation
findings.evidence: reviewer ran the real gate with expires:'whenever' and '2026-13-45' -> PASS, exit 0 (Invalid Date < now is false)
findings.resolution: reject an unparseable expires with die(2) before the comparison; added a discriminating test (unparseable expires -> exit 2); re-verified test 10/10, ADR Confirmation updated

findings.title: @security scenario tags only harvested from a single line
findings.question: error-handling
findings.whatBreaks: a valid Gherkin scenario with @security and @owasp:<topic> on separate lines was not matched, giving a spurious FAIL (safe direction, but an undocumented constraint that would bite adopters)
findings.evidence: reviewer read the harvest loop (only lines containing @security were scanned); shipped scenarios are single-line so no current defect
findings.resolution: rewrote the harvest to collect every @-token from each contiguous tag block that carries @security (single or multi line); added a test (separate-line tags -> pass); re-verified
